note: What each package channel is serving or being prepared to serve. Publishing is always a deliberate act through the protected distribution workflow; cargo exo-dev release feed-drift reads the feeds and reports, and never publishes anything.

github.note: The GitHub Release is the source every other channel downloads from. 0.10.1 becomes the published version at its own release cut.

chocolatey.note: The thin package installs the official 0.10.1 MSI. Preparation, validation and the rehearsal run before the protected submission.

winget.note: The manifests install the official 0.10.1 MSI with the Microsoft.VCRedist.2015+.x64 dependency.

scoop.note: The official bucket Exoridus/scoop-exosnap installs the pruned portable ZIP and is updated by the protected distribution workflow.
